warnings.head: THIRD CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) WARNING ON SEA LEVEL RISE Sea level rise is expected over the waters of East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan until Sunday, 22 November 2026. At risk of inundation of seawater over the coast. 2) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • Terengganu • Kelantan • Western Sarawak until 9:00 PM; Sunday, 22 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (THIRD CATEGOR

warnings.head: THUNDERSTORMS WARNING
warnings.text: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the states of Perlis • Kedah (Langkawi, Kubang Pasu, Padang Terap, Sik, Baling, Kota Setar and Pokok Sena) • Perak (Hulu Perak, Manjung, Perak Tengah, Hilir Perak, Bagan Datuk, Batang Padang, Muallim, Kinta and Kampar) • Selangor (Kuala Langat, Klang, Kuala Selangor, Petaling, Sabak Bernam and Sepang) • W.P. Kuala Lumpur • W.P. Putrajaya • Sarawak: Kuching (Kuching), Serian, Samarahan, Betong (Pusa and Saratok), Sibu, Kapit (Song, Kapit and Bukit Mabong), Sarikei (Maradong and Sarikei), Bintulu (Tatau) • Sabah: Interior (Beaufort, Sipitang and Tenom) until 8:00 PM; Sunday, 22 November 2026.
